modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Adjective Order Lessons
modules.instructions: Master determiner order, opinion-to-purpose sequencing, and comma rules to describe nouns accurately and naturally. Understand when adjectives are interchangeable and when their order is fixed.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write noun phrases using multiple adjectives in the correct DOSASCOMP order (Determiner, Opinion, Size, Age, Shape, Colour, Origin, Material, Purpose). Apply comma and 'and' rules in real contexts.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Grammar Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice ordering opinion, size, age, shape, colour, origin, material, and purpose adjectives before nouns. Recognise which sequences sound natural in English.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Adjective Order Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply determiner placement, multi-adjective sequencing, and comma or 'and' usage correctly in sentences. Master purpose adjectives that sit directly before the noun.
